title: The image of the constant sheaf under the geometric Langlands equivalence
summary: Let $X$ be a smooth projective curve and let $G$ be a reductive group over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. We compute the image of arbitrary finite-rank local systems on $\mathrm{Bun}_G(X)$ under the geometric Langlands equivalence, confirming a conjecture of V. Lafforgue in the case of the constant sheaf.
